schema: orchid-mlip-calibration-v2 (layout of orchid-data espei/dft/CALIBRATION.json: method, pairs_release, sources{source: {all, strata}}, lso; plus same_set, mlip_vs_dft, per_compound_median, variants, saturation, health, models)

chemistry_classes.magnetic_3d: contains Cr, Mn, Fe, Co or Ni (and no p-block / anion element)
chemistry_classes.metal: all-metal intermetallic (none of the elements below)
chemistry_classes.pblock_anion: contains a p-block / anion element (H, B, C, N, O, F, Si, P, S, Se, Te, As, Sb, halogens)

method.ci_cluster: ci95_cluster_system: resample chemical systems with all their pairs (quote this one)
method.excluded: pairs whose MLIP relaxation (compound or elemental reference) did not converge, errored or exploded; pairs whose matched MP entry is not among the computed structures

match_quality.above_hull: lowest DFT entry at the composition lies more than 1 meV/atom (0.0965 kJ/mol-atom, the numerical precision of the DFT energies) above the hull
match_quality.on_hull_single: DFT entry on the hull and the only entry at its composition
match_quality.polymorph_ambiguous: on the hull, several entries (polymorphs) at the composition

method.pairs: build_espei_bundle.calibration_pairs (orchid-project.org 181ebd6001): DFT pairs exactly as the DFT calibration; an MLIP pair = the MP pair of the same record with the MLIP formation enthalpy of the same matched MP entry (structure-matched polymorph when the record names one)
method.residual: MLIP - experiment, kJ/mol-atom (rounded to 1e-3 as dft_parity res)

variants.corr: plus the MP energy correction of the matched entries (compound minus composition-weighted elemental corrections), unless the model predicts corrected energies
variants.relax: MLIP relaxation (FIRE + FrechetCellFilter, fmax 0.02 eV/A, <= 1000 steps) of the DFT-relaxed MP structure; elemental references = MP ground states relaxed alike
variants.sp: MLIP single point on the DFT-relaxed structure

pairs_release: dft_parity.json sha256 d18f96578a09b1cf311d238c06846bb51c87ca357eef5fa04df7570288ecae3f (literature sha256 84bf790a79f08cc53f21a3f8f027a00bce210863ad63de51d56f626c87058e9b); inputs sha256 structures.json d24f3ad5efe0195a4b3e12145188daf14640fd39ac97fd6c89e4bff3c801e858, structures_addendum_r2.json 58086d695e9c706753f8b84dddfe1c8b60b05d79bf63d8f84abe3f484c35692d
